subject: Renewal: PacificCare — EU residency + APAC rollout / cross-region failover
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@pacificcare.health>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@pacificcare.health>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal plan + EU residency & APAC expansion options

Hi Samantha —

Happy renewal season. PacificCare's annual commitment is up 10/01 and I wanted to align on two items that came up in our Q2 review:

1) Data residency for EU patients: you asked for EU-only residency for newly onboarded workflows (billing and patient summaries). We have a standard EU region package and an addendum I can attach.
2) APAC rollout & DR: you mentioned a pilot in APAC next year and asked about cross-region failover for low-latency reads. We can enable an APAC replica + async KV replication; that'll change capacity sizing and costs.

If it helps, I can propose two renewal options:
- Option A: 12-month renewal, EU residency add-on, 20% capacity uplift for APAC pilot, standard SLA
- Option B: 24-month renewal, lower per-token price, EU residency + prioritized APAC rollout + cross-region failover (SLA 99.9% with RTO targets)

I'm looping in Evelyn (Customer Success) to confirm migration timeline and Mina (security) for the residency appendix. Grace from solutions can confirm the throughput sizing for cross-region traffic.

Next steps: can we schedule a 30-min to walk the two options? If you prefer, I can send an amendment and cost table first.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_AMENDMENT_v2.pdf (proposal), PC-DataResidency-Appendix.docx (draft)
From: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@pacificcare.health>

Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:07:12 +0100
Subject: Re: Renewal plan + EU residency & APAC expansion options

Thanks Marcus —

Appreciate the options. A few clarifying questions before we book time:

- For EU residency: does the addendum cover encrypted-at-rest keys managed by our KMS? We require customer-managed keys for PHI-scope documents.
- For APAC pilot: what latency numbers should we expect from Sydney to the APAC replica (p50/p95)? Can you share any benchmarks?
- Cross-region failover: is failover automatic or manual? We need a documented RTO and a test plan for DR exercises.

Procurement (cc'd) will want the amendment and a redline-ready contract. Please send the amendment and a cost delta for Option A vs B.

Best,
Samantha
Director of Digital Transformation | PacificCare Health

On Thu, Aug 13, 2026 at 10:07 AM Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@pacificcare.health> wrote:
> Thanks Marcus —
> 
> Appreciate the options. A few clarifying questions before we book time:
> 
> - For EU residency: does the addendum cover encrypted-at-rest keys managed by our KMS? We require customer-managed keys for PHI-scope documents.
> - For APAC pilot: what latency numbers should we expect from Sydney to the APAC replica (p50/p95)? Can you share any benchmarks?
> - Cross-region failover: is failover automatic or manual? We need a documented RTO and a test plan for DR exercises.

Thanks for the questions — answers below and attaching the draft appendix.

- KMS/Encryption: Yes. The PC-DataResidency-Appendix includes an optional KMS integration clause (customer-managed keys via supported KMS providers). Mina, could you confirm the supported KMS list and any additional attestation language we need to include for PHI?
- APAC latency & benchmarks: Grace, can you add a short table with p50/p95 for Sydney -> APAC replica on the 2x A100 profile? Early numbers: p50 ~ 45ms, p95 ~ 120ms depending on sequence length and batching. We'll confirm with a small perf run.
- Failover behavior: Cross-region failover is configurable. We can offer an automated passive failover (with health-check gating) or a manual failover procedure. Automated failover has a longer RTO in some edge cases; for critical PHI reads we recommend a tested manual failover plan with a documented RTO (target 5–10 minutes in our recommended config).

I'll attach the amendment (v2) and the residency appendix. If Proc needs the contract redline-ready, we'll follow up with Legal but can provide a mark-up for signatures.

Marcus

Hi all —

Quick security confirmation: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, and Google Cloud KMS. We'll include explicit language in the appendix that all PHI-scope artefacts are encrypted at rest with CMKs and the customer retains key rotation control.

For SOC and attestations: we'll append the SOC 2 Type II summary and an addendum referencing data residency controls (logical separation, ingress/egress auditing, and region-limited backups). I recommend adding a quarterly compliance report to the contract for the first 12 months post-migration.

I'll attach the SOC excerpt and propose redline text for the KMS clause by end of day.

—Mina

Hey team —

Perf numbers (preliminary): using the 2x A100 profile and our prefix caching, Sydney -> APAC replica observed:
- p50: 42ms (token streaming enabled, short prompts)
- p95: 110–140ms (longer sequences and model warm starts)

Capacity guidance for APAC pilot: recommend 25% of EU baseline for first 6 months with autoscale headroom to 50% for marketing/spike events. For cross-region KV replication, plan an hourly async sync with priority queueing for critical patient documents — replicating writes immediately will increase write-latency and cost.

I'll include a one-page summary in the Drive folder and a recommended test plan for failover exercises (manual runbook + automated failover checklist).

Grace
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
